name: X-37B OTV-1 (USA-212)
first: USA-212 — 224 days on orbit, Vandenberg AFB
description: First flight of the Boeing-built X-37B Orbital Test Vehicle programme. Launched 2010-04-22 23:52 UTC from Cape Canaveral SLC-41 on Atlas V 501 AV-012; the first autonomous orbital spaceplane re-entry under runway-landing operations since the Soviet Buran 1.01 in 1988. Landed at Vandenberg AFB 2010-12-03 09:16 UTC after 224 days. Payloads and orbital parameters classified.

events.label: LANDING
events.note: Autonomous runway landing at Vandenberg AFB 2010-12-03.
